_note: Prototype org-context file. The org (Northwind Logistics) is fictional demo data. The five pillars and ten systems below are PLACEHOLDERS until the real LeadOS framework is dropped in; keep the ids stable and change names/descriptions freely.

values.name: Own it end to end
values.meaning: We follow work through to the customer outcome, not just our part of it.

values.name: Say the hard thing kindly
values.meaning: We raise problems early and directly, with care for the person.

values.name: Customers feel the difference
values.meaning: Decisions are judged by what changes for the customer.

managerStandards: Every direct report has a 1:1 at least every two weeks, and it is rarely cancelled.
Feedback is given within 48 hours of the moment it relates to.
Performance concerns are raised early, stated with specific examples, and shared with your HR business partner before any formal step.
Team meetings end with clear owners and dates for every action.
Each quarter, every team member can say what the team's top three priorities are.

pillars.name: Clarity
pillars.summary: The team knows where it is going and what matters most.

pillars.name: Coaching
pillars.summary: Each person is growing and knows how they are doing.

pillars.name: Team
pillars.summary: The team works well together and decides well.

pillars.name: Standards
pillars.summary: Expectations are clear and gaps are dealt with early.

pillars.name: Self
pillars.summary: The manager manages their own energy, time and learning.
